A '''Zink-sled''' was a type of toy vehicle that children played with.<ref name="DR">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>

The brothers [[Chuck Bratz|Chuck]] and [[Donni Bratz]] owned one. During a fight between the two, Chuck tied Donni to the zink-sled with the missing right rear gimble and set it going until Donni threw up all over their [[Mother Bratz|Mom's]] newly upholstered lounge chair.<ref name="DR" />
